question: What central conflict is explored in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights the challenge of balancing freedom of speech with preventing harm online.
 
• It discusses the rapid spread of content on social media, including hate speech, misinformation, and cyberbullying.
 
• The conflict is between allowing individuals to express themselves freely and the responsibility to protect vulnerable users from online harm.
 
• Other options like law vs. religion, profit vs. loss, or privacy vs. piracy do not capture the central theme of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3: Freedom vs. online harm**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Law vs. religion** (कानून बनाम धर्म): Not discussed; the passage does not explore religious conflicts.
 
• **Profit vs. loss** (मुनाफा बनाम हानि): Irrelevant; financial aspects are not the focus.
 
• **Privacy vs. piracy** (गोपनीयता बनाम समुद्री डकैती): Not mentioned; the passage focuses on speech and online harm.

The correct answer is Option 3<
